$comment: Per-package fixes for scripts/third-party-notices.ts. Each entry needs a reason; an entry that matches no shipped package fails the generator. Fields: text (replacement license text, needs source), source (where text came from), identifier (replacement SPDX id), cutBefore (keep the license file up to this line).

react-remove-scroll-bar.reason: Declares MIT in package.json (author Anton Korzunov) but publishes no license file. The text is the LICENSE file in the upstream repository, which was added after the 2.3.8 tag.
